Batch 6 (`cm-math-canonical` / `cm-math-canonical-examples`) is complete and frozen for handoff. Summary of the final state:

## What was delivered

**22 items (18 A + 4 B)** plus both page carriers, all `domain: mathematics`:
- **E7 — symplectic calculus, canonical maps, Hamilton–Jacobi:** phase domain/forms; closedness & nondegeneracy of the standard two-form; `X_H = J∇H`, Hamilton equations, Poisson bracket; flow-derivative identity `YᵀJY=J`, `det Y=1`; volume preservation; canonical-map matrix test and Hamiltonian transport; first/second-kind generating functions, canonicity, local converse; the cylinder shift's global obstruction; the Hamilton–Jacobi equation, complete integral, characteristics, Jacobi constants, local converse and canonical `(β,α)` labels; four B-page worked checks.

Hessian notation tied to `def-hessian-and-euclidean-critical-point`; `det S_{αq}=det S_{qα}` given its transpose justification; slicewise Leibniz application in the radial-primitive lemma; cylinder global-failure reduction corrected; time-dependent generating-function statement trimmed to exactly what is proved.
